lines.zh: 我掠过草原，尾巴拖着火。
lines.en: I skim the savanna, trailing fire from my tail.
One beat of my wings bends the grass.
I glide far on the hot wind.
Little sparks burst from my feather tips.
I fly along the dry-season riverbed.

lines.zh: 金红的影子落在枯草上。
lines.en: A gold-red shadow falls on the dry grass.
I circle upward.

lines.zh: 每一次振翅都带起一股热浪。
lines.en: Each wingbeat throws off a wave of heat.

lines.zh: 我从树梢上方俯掠而过。
lines.en: I sweep low over the treetops.
My tail feathers burn behind me.
I cut slantwise across the sunlight.

lines.zh: 我落在枯枝上，枝头冒烟。
lines.en: I land on a dry branch, and it smokes.

lines.zh: 我收着翅膀，身上的火很静。
lines.en: Wings folded, my fire burns quietly.
I wait for the sun to climb higher.
Sparks fall at my feet and go out.
I lower my head to preen my breast.
This savanna is dry in just the right way.
There is not a speck of ash on my feathers.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，眼里有火在滚。
lines.en: I blink slowly, fire rolling in my eyes.

lines.zh: 热风把我的羽吹得发亮。
lines.en: The hot wind makes my plumage shine.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖尾羽，冒出一缕烟。
lines.en: I shake my tail and a wisp of smoke rises.

lines.zh: 草原上安静得只剩虫声。
lines.en: Only insects stir on the savanna.
I listen to see if the wind will turn.

lines.zh: 我的一根旧羽落在灰土上。
lines.en: An old feather of mine falls on the dusty ground.
I lift my head and my neck feathers flare.
The fire inside me burns slowly.

lines.zh: 我不需要走动，也能巡视。
lines.en: I need not walk to keep watch.
The sun has moved west; the light has changed.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，也在发热。
lines.en: My shadow is long, and warm as well.
I stand on the tallest dead tree.
You have been looking up a long while.
My firelight could hurt you.

lines.zh: 你手里没有能挡住火的东西。
lines.en: You hold nothing that could stop fire.
On this savanna, you are very small.
I am watching the shadow you cast.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，像一棵枯树。
lines.en: You stand there like a dead tree.
I do not go looking for trouble.
Take three steps back and I will fold my wings.
The sun is in your eyes. That suits me.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛落在你脚边，会烫。
lines.en: My feather at your feet will be hot.
You smell of sweat. Very salt.

lines.zh: 你抬头说话，火星落进你头发。
lines.en: You look up to speak, and sparks fall in your hair.
One of my feathers is scorched.
My fire dimmed for a moment.
I retreat into the air, feathers scattering.
That cost me my composure.
I let out a harsh shriek.
Sparks spill from the wound.
I beat my wings to steady myself.
Blood falls on the burnt ground.
The fire in my eyes burns redder.
You have made me angry.
Hold it a little higher.
I do not eat it. I am only curious.
My firelight illuminates your face.
The ember in your palm — give it to me.

lines.zh: 把果子搁在石上，别伸手。
lines.en: Set the fruit on the stone and keep your hands back.

lines.zh: 这东西经不起我的温度。
lines.en: This will not survive my heat.
I lean in for a closer look.

lines.zh: 草原上少有送上门的东西。
lines.en: Few things come to me unbidden on the savanna.
I have received your gesture.
Take it further off, or it will catch fire.
You brushed my plumage; it is hot.
The bump dropped me half a wingbeat.
My fire dimmed under that impact.
Sparks rise between us.
You pulled away, your sleeve smoking.
My feathers are light; they will not bruise you.
That set the grass alight.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，火苗扫过去。
lines.en: I turn aside and the flame sweeps past.

lines.zh: 地面被我们踩出一片黑。
lines.en: We leave a black patch on the ground.

lines.zh: 你再近一步就要着火了。
lines.en: One more step and you will catch fire.
We fly side by side over the savanna.

lines.zh: 我的火和你的火撞在一起。
lines.en: My fire meets yours.
Fly a circle with me; the fire will know you.

lines.zh: 枯树顶够我们两个落脚。
lines.en: The dead treetop has room for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们把火压低，别烧到草。
lines.en: We keep our fire low so as not to burn the grass.

lines.zh: 你的羽色比我的暗一些。
lines.en: Your plumage is a shade darker than mine.

lines.zh: 雨季来之前，我们还有时间。
lines.en: We have time before the rains come.

lines.zh: 我把我的一根羽毛给你。
lines.en: I give you one of my feathers.
Take off and ride my updraft.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这片旱草原。
lines.en: We keep this dry savanna together.
I take it in my talons, and it smokes.

lines.zh: 烫手的东西我不敢多拿。
lines.en: I do not hold hot things for long.
I nudge it with my beak.
This dry branch will do to start a fire.
I drop it into the flames.
It turns to charcoal under my grip.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛，我叼起来试了试。
lines.en: This feather; I lift it in my beak to test it.

lines.zh: 我把它放在草地上，退开。
lines.en: I set it on the grass and step back.
My fire is not hot enough to consume it.

lines.zh: 我从灰里捡起来，还是烫的。
lines.en: I pick it from the ash; still hot.
I see you coming closer.
My feathers are beginning to rise.
You need to learn the distance of fire.

lines.zh: 我升起来了，从上面看你。
lines.en: I rise and look down at you.
You stepped out of the grass. Too visible.
There is no cover in this stretch.
Fire has gathered in my throat.

lines.zh: 你要是聪明，就往水边走。
lines.en: If you are wise, head for the water.

lines.zh: 你踩过干草的声音，我全听见。
lines.en: I hear every step you take through the dry grass.

lines.zh: 热风把你的方向吹给我了。
lines.en: The hot wind carries your direction to me.
I circle above your head, second loop.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直在你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow never leaves your feet.
Look up and there I am.

lines.zh: 草原太干，你的靴子会冒烟。
lines.en: The savanna is dry; your boots will start smoking.
My fire has not fallen yet.
There is no water in the direction you run.
I have closed half the distance.
The wind on the savanna favors me.

lines.zh: 草原上空，我烧出的光很刺眼。
lines.en: Over the savanna my fire glares.
When the sun is overhead, it is time.
I dive, and flame arrives first.
A ball of fire lands before your feet.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓住了你的肩。
lines.en: My talons catch your shoulder.
My wings sweep up a sheet of sparks.
The grass is burning, and you cannot back away.

lines.zh: 我从火里穿过去，毫发无损。
lines.en: I pass through the flames unharmed.
That blow came with heat.
My tail feathers brush you.
Smoke sets you coughing.

lines.zh: 我又升起来，准备下一次。
lines.en: I rise again, ready for the next pass.

lines.zh: 我从草尖的火星里升起来。
lines.en: I rise from sparks on the grass tips.

lines.zh: 旱草原上多了一片红光。
lines.en: A red glow has come to the dry savanna.

lines.zh: 我落在枯树上，树开始烧。
lines.en: I land on a dead tree, and it begins to burn.
The hot wind lifts me up.

lines.zh: 我展开翅膀，天边亮了一下。
lines.en: I spread my wings and the horizon brightens.
Fire breaks out of my feathers.
This savanna knows me.
I heard distant thunder first.
I rise from the ashes.
The wind feeds my fire.
A firebird alights before you.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上拖得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long across the grass.

lines.zh: 火对我不算什么，可你的火不是我的。
lines.en: Fire is nothing to me — but yours is not mine.

lines.zh: 我撞在地上，羽上全是灰。
lines.en: I strike the ground, ash all over my plumage.

lines.zh: 水压住我的火，翅膀变沉。
lines.en: Water smothers my fire and my wings grow heavy.
The blast shreds my tail feathers.
An arrow passed through my wing.

lines.zh: 这股力量冷得熄了我一半的火。
lines.en: That force is cold enough to half extinguish me.

lines.zh: 旱季太长了，我虚得发飘。
lines.en: The dry season is too long; I feel faint.
Lightning collides with my fire.

lines.zh: 没有风，没有热，我直往下坠。
lines.en: No wind, no heat — I fall straight down.
